item.title: The London bars to fall in love with (and in)
item.description: A guide to the most romantic bars the British capital has to offer, made for connection, conversation, and second rounds

item.title: The Stärke Gen 2 Speedster’s blend of vintage looks and modern mechanicals intrigue
item.description: The Gen 2 isn’t quite a restomod and it’s certainly not a brand-new car. Instead, a Missouri-based company has created a FrankenPorsche for the mash-up generation

item.title: Wallpaper* Design Awards: Louis Vuitton reimagines its 130-year-old monogram anew
item.description: We named this celebratory Speedy bag our ‘Best Party Bag’ for its fresh take on a monogram which redefined luxury style

item.title: Chopard partners with Italian automotive house Zagato for its lightest-ever concept watch
item.description: A radical exercise in weight, structure and intent, the Lab One Zagato Concept translates automotive spaceframe engineering into haute horology, pushing Chopard into boldly experimental territory

item.title: The world has a new hypercar: meet the Capricorn 01 Zagato
item.description: Blending Italian style with German craftsmanship and materials science, Capricorn’s multi-million-euro hypercar means business, both on the road and in the portfolio

item.title: A home true to its name, Serene brings minimalist calm to London’s Queens Park
item.description: This textured, new-build home by Coeus London was created to foster a sense of ‘slowing down’ and a connection with nature in the heart of the city

item.title: Finally, a London members’ club restaurant worth joining for
item.description: At The Roof Gardens, the Roman and Williams-designed Komorebi is a restaurant where Japanese precision meets cinematic light above the city

item.title: The intriguing backstory of Balenciaga’s new factory in Tuscany
item.description: Tour The Plant, the luxury house’s new leather goods production facility and training centre that reuses and regenerates an existing industrial site

item.title: A spectacular Rudolph Schindler residence is back on the market for $2.5 million
item.description: The Los Angeles house, perched in the Hollywood Hills, even has a swimming pool rumoured to have been designed by Richard Neutra

item.title: Star florists take centre stage at Madrid Blooms
item.description: Floral design is having a major moment: Sylvia Bustamante Gubbins, founder and director of Madrid Blooms, tells Wallpaper* how floristry has evolved into a global, glamorous and increasingly influential creative industry
